saw_lines: People don’t buy a shoe twice because it’s sustainable. They buy it again because it felt good on day one.
So every new drop has to sell comfort first and materials second, on every channel at once.
Dasher NZ leads your homepage, and you run six channels under Follow The Flock. One comfort story, cut for all six, every drop.
